workflow_steps.title: Reproject hospital locations to metric CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform the hospital point geometries from EPSG:4326 into a projected CRS with meter units suitable for distance buffering.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the input hospital vector layer from its observed EPSG:4326 CRS to EPSG:26918. Preserve all features and attributes and write the result as GeoPackage.

workflow_steps.title: Create 1-km hospital buffers
workflow_steps.purpose: Create a 1-kilometer buffer polygon around each hospital location.
workflow_steps.instructions: Buffer every feature in the projected_hospitals layer by 1000 meters. Preserve the hospital attributes and write the buffer polygons as GeoPackage.
